description: Check a children's product lab test report before the importer certifies. Upload the report PDF as file, or paste its text as text. Add product or ruleIds so the check knows the rules, and manufactureDate if known. Scores gaps: a rule the report does not cite, a failed result, a lab CPSC does not accept for that test, a test before the lab's acceptance, an old ASTM F963 edition, and missing or wrong dates. Returns a readiness score, each gap with how to fix it, and draft values for the CPSC eFiling certificate fields. It never says a filing is correct.

file.description: The lab test report the user uploaded (a text PDF or a .txt file).

download_url.description: Temporary link to the uploaded file.

labId.description: The lab's CPSC lab ID, when the report does not show it

manufactureDate.description: When the goods were made, YYYY-MM-DD

product.description: What the product is and who it is for, such as "plush toy for ages 3+", so missing rules can be found

ruleIds.description: Rule ids from find_cert_rules, instead of product

text.description: The report text, when the user pasted it instead of uploading a file

name: check_lab_report
title: Check a lab report
